headline: Eight new AWS Network Firewall commands; SOC Framework Pack Manager 1.1.0 reworks pack installation
summary_md:
- **Amazon Web Services 2.5.0** added eight `aws-network-firewall-*` commands covering resource policies, resource tagging and logging configuration.
- **SOC Framework Pack Manager 1.1.0** now upgrades packs in place instead of installing each release as a separate pack, adds a `diagnose` action, and no longer needs the *XSIAMContentPackInstaller* automation.
- Three ingestion and mirroring fixes: **CrowdStrike Falcon** event fetch past 10,000 records, **SplunkPy v2** mirror-out to Splunk Enterprise Security 8.2.x, and **Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps** dropping low-volume event types.
- Cloud Posture remediation content moved off the deprecated `azure-nsg-*` and `azure-disk-*` commands onto the new `azure-vn-*` and `azure-compute-*` names.
- An automated Docker bump touched 85 packs, and eight core packs were re-released as dependency locks with no functional change.

highlights.title: AWS gains resource-policy, tagging and logging commands for Network Firewall
highlights.detail: Six commands manage resource policies and tags on rule groups and firewall policies, and two describe or update a firewall's logging configuration.

highlights.title: SOC Framework Pack Manager stopped installing every release as its own pack
highlights.detail: It also stripped a trailing non-version component from pack names such as soc-v3-tools, installing them under the wrong pack ID, and compared pre-release suffixes so 1.0.6-pr1008 ranked above 1.0.7.

highlights.title: CrowdStrike Falcon event fetch failed beyond 10,000 records
highlights.detail: Fetching events errored with "offset + limit must be less than or equal to 10000".

highlights.title: SplunkPy v2 mirror-out to Splunk Enterprise Security 8.2.x fixed
highlights.detail: The outgoing finding mapper was updated for 8.2.x, and the processed-mirrored-events cache made concurrency-safe so parallel executions no longer overwrite each other's integration context.

highlights.title: Cloud Posture playbooks moved to the new Azure command names
highlights.detail: NSG remediation now calls azure-vn-security-rule-* and the public-access auto-remediation calls azure-compute-disk-update; the rule creation argument action was renamed access.

highlights.title: Active Directory Query v2 can write binary attribute values
highlights.detail: A new optional attribute-type argument adds Octet String support to ad-update-user, ad-update-contact and ad-update-group.

items.Packs/AWS: Added eight aws-network-firewall-* commands: resource policy put/describe/delete, resource tag/untag, tag listing, and logging configuration describe/update.
items.Packs/SocFrameworkManager: 1.1.0 installs packs in place, resolves mandatory dependencies before installing, adds a diagnose action and a Pack catalog URL parameter, and surfaces upload failures.
items.Packs/CrowdStrikeFalcon: Fixed event fetching failing with an "offset + limit must be less than or equal to 10000" error.
items.Packs/SplunkPy: Fixed mirror-out to Splunk Enterprise Security 8.2.x and made the processed mirrored events cache concurrency-safe; outgoing mapper updated for 8.2.x.
items.Packs/MicrosoftCloudAppSecurity: Event collector now fetches up to 1000 events per type per cycle, no longer drops low-volume event types, and isolates a failure in one type from the others.
items.Packs/CloudSecurityPolicyManagement: NSG remediation playbook and AzureIdentifyNSGExposureRule moved to the azure-vn-* commands; the rule creation argument action was renamed access.
items.Packs/CloudSecurityPostureManagement: Azure Public Access Misconfiguration auto-remediation replaced the deprecated azure-disk-update with azure-compute-disk-update.
items.Packs/Active_Directory_Query: Added an attribute-type argument for binary (Octet String) values in ad-update-user, ad-update-contact and ad-update-group.
items.Packs/VMwareVCenter: Fixed VM Operations hostname mapping when descriptions contain repeated spaces, and stopped mapping extended envoy access logs by classic field positions.
items.Packs/Vega: Alert event JSON fields are parsed and fields._raw promoted to top level, expanding dotted and {}-suffixed keys; added the Vega.AlertEvents.Events context output.
items.Packs/ImageOCR: image-ocr-extract-text now returns a warning instead of erroring on an empty or truncated image file.
items.Packs/CommonScripts: ReadQRCode now returns a warning entry instead of erroring on a zero-byte image file.
